question: A 5-man group made up of one tank, one healer, and three DPS is doing a dungeon that was just released in World of Warcraft. Two are plate wearers and two are cloth wearers. At the final boss, both the tank and the healer are casting holy spells. Ice and fire are being used, each one by a different DPS. A bear from the group is attacking the boss. Metamorphosis is cast. The Kilt of the Forgotten One drops as loot, but no one can use it. If all classes were using their class abilities and all classes are unique, what are the five classes in the group in alphabetical order separated by commas?
ground_truth: Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content:
We need to identify the 5 unique classes based on the clues. Key constraints: 1 tank, 1 healer, 3 DPS; exactly two plate wearers and two cloth wearers; both tank and healer casting holy spells; ice and fire each used by different DPS; a bear from the group attacking the boss; Metamorphosis is cast; leather Kilt of the Forgotten One drops but no one can equip it. Likely checks: whether Metamorphosis refers to Warlock (Wrath-era) or Demon Hunter (Legion-era), and what Kilt of the Forgotten One is exactly. Also clarify what could count as the "ice" DPS effect in a WotLK context.

Team plan:
- WebSurfer: Verify the source/era of Metamorphosis and confirm Kilt of the Forgotten One armor type and source. Also look up WotLK Hunter abilities related to ice usage.
- Assistant: Synthesize constraints and assemble a class set that fits roles, armor counts, and ability clues.
- FileSurfer: On standby if we need to review any saved notes or lists.

WebSurfer, please check: (a) whether Metamorphosis existed for Demonology Warlocks in Wrath and its timeline vs Demon Hunter, (b) Kilt of the Forgotten One item type and drop source, and (c) whether WotLK Hunters had an ice-themed ability like Freezing Arrow/Freezing Trap usable in combat that could count as "ice being used."

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content:
Findings from quick searches:
- Metamorphosis timeline: Demonology Warlocks gained Metamorphosis in Wrath of the Lich King (patch 3.0 era). The ability was later removed from Warlocks and became iconic for Demon Hunters introduced in Legion. So in a WotLK context or WotLK Classic "just released" framing, Metamorphosis points to a Warlock.
- Kilt of the Forgotten One: Wowhead page indicates it is leather legs dropped by Herald Volazj in Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom (Wrath 5-man). If no one can use it, that implies no leather wearer present.
- Hunter ice usage in WotLK: Hunters had Freezing Arrow (added in Wrath) which shoots a Freezing Trap at range; also Frost Trap effects existed. While primarily crowd control/utility, it is an ice/frost-based effect being actively used by a Hunter in combat. If the wording only requires that "ice is being used by a DPS," a Hunter using Freezing Arrow/Trap could satisfy that without requiring a Mage or Frost Death Knight.

Extra contextual notes (may be relevant to interpretation):
- The puzzle says the dungeon was "just released"; if interpreted as WotLK Classic release timing, Demon Hunters do not exist yet, reinforcing the Warlock Metamorphosis reading. Also, some modern transmog changes post-Legion altered how appearances are "usable" vs equippable; however, in original Wrath era, "no one can use" leather legs straightforwardly means no leather classes in the party.
- I can also look up patch notes on Freezing Arrow behavior and transmog usability flags if needed to refine what "use" means here.

history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Synthesis based on constraints and the findings:
- Holy tank and holy healer suggest Paladin (tank) and Priest (healer).
- Metamorphosis strongly indicates a Demonology Warlock (Wrath-era), who can also account for the fire usage (Destruction) while the demo spec offers the Metamorphosis cast.
- A bear attacking the boss is naturally satisfied by a Hunter bringing a bear pet.
- Two plate wearers and two cloth wearers: Plate can be Paladin plus Warrior; Cloth can be Priest and Warlock. The fifth would then be the Hunter (mail). That leaves no leather users, matching the Kilt of the Forgotten One being leather and unusable by anyone in the group.
- Ice and fire each by different DPS: fire can be attributed to the Warlock; ice can be attributed to the Hunter through Freezing Arrow/Trap usage during combat. Since the clue says "being used" and does not require damage, this covers the ice usage without introducing a Mage or Frost DK.

Proposed five classes (alphabetical): Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock, Warrior.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Final answer (alphabetical): Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock, Warrior

mistake_reason: The WebSurfer drifted from the core objective and introduced an off-track reinterpretation by focusing on release timelines (WotLK vs Legion), transmog usability semantics, and treating Hunter crowd control (Freezing Arrow/Trap) as satisfying the 'ice' DPS clue. This task derailment (FM-2.3) reframed the requirement away from identifying the most direct class mapping for 'ice' damage (Frost Death Knight) and led the team to replace Death Knight with Warrior, yielding the wrong class set.
